title: help extraction is normalized in fourteen files but edm-sync-canonical-sections still has no EDM-HELP sentinels and keys its extractor on the literal set -euo pipefail line; two extractor renderings, three extractor arguments and a four-way -h/--help/help dispatch split remain, and the prescribed CI ban on the hardcoded-range form was never added

test:smoke-bash32 now runs apk add --no-cache jq git on the Alpine-based bash:3.2 image and asserts the running bash is 3.2 at :303, so the declared end-to-end proof of the bash 3.2 constraint is reachable

the two mirrored ignore-set copies are gone -- build_line_classes has exactly one definition in the shared library, it de-indents before measuring the backtick run, and edm-lint-artifacts, edm-check-grants and edm-check-vocabulary all source it

the mirrored-VERBATIM comments were removed from both checkers but the assertion guarding the shared-library boundary still greps edm-check-grants for the dead symbol build_ignore_set and passes on call sites, so it would pass equally if the source line were deleted and the helpers pasted back in

wave4b now emits the standard Results: N passed, M failed line, run-all.sh carries a single parser at :65, and a crashed suite, a zero-assertion suite and an exit-0-without-summary suite are each named distinctly at :77-99 (L7 element only; the suite-count floor is L4's)
plan now grants Edit like every other artifact-writing phase skill, and Gate 1's decisions.md append at :79-83 is the same in-place row shape Gate 2 uses

wave7 now roots its scratch trees at a TMPDIR-honoring mktemp template and traps EXIT INT TERM like wave6, so the untrapped hand-rolled /tmp directories are gone (L7 element only; residual trap-shape divergence in the three older suites raised separately)
each pinned digest is now spelled once behind an anchor -- .alpine_edm at :42 and .node_edm at :46 -- and validate:manifest consumes the alpine anchor at :373 instead of re-hardcoding the digest

all three gate curation blocks now prescribe the Grep tool rather than a literal shell grep (code-audit:325, audit-srd:162, audit-tickets:180), and implement no longer carries the unused Bash(grep *) grant

edm-lint-artifacts and edm-check-grants moved to BASH_SOURCE but edm-check-vocabulary:56, edm-sync-canonical-sections:32, wave4b-smoke.sh:6 and wave6-smoke.sh:714 still derive the root four different ways under two names, and the vocabulary site now sources the shared library off its $0-derived path

die() still has four shapes across eleven scripts with edm-lint-artifacts defaulting to exit 1 among siblings defaulting to 2, edm-validate-prefix still inverts the family exit codes and additionally prints the exit code inside its own message via $*, and neither set -uo site got the comment the remediation asked for
both validate jobs now declare needs: [] (:374 and :482), so they start at pipeline start instead of waiting for the whole lint and test stages they depend on no job in

the unjustified git install was dropped from lint:grants and lint:vocabulary and the library-doc count is now computed at :246, but lint:bash-syntax, lint:artifacts and lint:shellcheck still print no terminal job-named verdict where four sibling lint jobs do
update-patterns moved from post-Approve sub-step 10.5 to step 9a, before the Convergence gate, matching both sibling audit skills' pre-gate placement, with the reason stated inline at :83-85
all four gates now append a decisions.md row in one shape -- Gate 1 at plan:79, Gate 2 at audit-srd:49, Gate 3 at audit-tickets:51, Convergence at code-audit:111

51 non-ASCII bytes remain across seven test files while wave6, wave7 and timing.sh are clean, and run-all.sh:50 still prints an em dash to stdout on every pipeline via the blocking test:smoke job, violating on stdout the ASCII rule its own suite asserts for every committed artifact

the False-Alarm-Filter lead-in is now uniform across all eleven lenses, but dead-code and logic still carry a Before reporting preamble and a closing line the other nine lack, in two phrasings that disagree on whether the criteria are conjunctive, and edm-audit-logic:73 still renders the canonical-severity clause as a bulleted field where ten render a bare sentence

unchanged -- e2e's Step-0 exit token is still a bare N/A that is a strict prefix of all five siblings, and a11y's bottom-of-file string at :136 still differs from its own Step-0 token at :20 while :138 claims they are the same, with N/A -- no UI a strict prefix of component's token

the shared-library extraction closed two of the three hand-copies named as round 1's largest root cause -- score-artifacts.sh does not source _edm-lint-lib.sh, still anchors its mermaid fence detector at column 1 where the canonical detector de-indents, and its header at :80-82 still says the sourceable file is not attempted here after that file landed

the shared report_violation probes for two caller-specific counter globals (violations, then VIOLATIONS) instead of resolving the naming divergence, so a consumer that names its counter anything else prints violations and exits 0 with no diagnostic, and one that declares both increments only the lowercase one

ignored_line_set() survives as a byte-identical four-line hand-copy in edm-check-grants and edm-check-vocabulary -- the two files the shared library was created to de-duplicate -- and was not lifted into _edm-lint-lib.sh alongside build_line_classes

scratch-tree setup diverges two ways across the suites -- wave3, wave4a and wave5 use a bare mktemp -d and trap EXIT only, while wave6 and wave7 use a TMPDIR-honoring named template and trap EXIT INT TERM, so a SIGINT during a local run leaks a tree from three of five and TMPDIR is honored by only two

test:smoke-bash32's floating bash:3.2 tag remains an authorized named exception with the rationale and refresh procedure recorded in place at :284-291; the apt-get divergence that shared this job is fixed and the version assertion is present at :303

the ignore set is still deliberately not applied to grant source 2 because the lens launch template lives inside a fence and skipping it would blind the checker to the instruction it exists to catch; carried forward unchanged, not re-litigated

edm-check-grants' actor-first output shape is now the five-argument arm of the shared report_violation and remains deliberate and required by T03 AC7; the arity-keyed dual format names its own misuse at :90-93, so only the counter-name half of that function is raised as a finding

eval:nightly merges *node_edm for the pinned digest and then overrides rules: at :522 -- correct per YAML merge-key precedence and the when: requirement is documented at :512-516, though the anchor bundles image and rules where this one consumer wants only the image

edm-check-grants and edm-check-vocabulary wrap is_ignored_line in a redundant [[ -n $ignore_set ]] guard the function already performs internally at _edm-lint-lib.sh:82 while edm-lint-artifacts calls it bare -- cosmetic, no behavioural difference in either direction
